Nina: Scheduling a quiet-window tilt tonight 22:30 UTC. Plan: pin router -> v3.2.2, warm prefixes, then phased weights: 2% -> 20% -> 70% -> 100%. 5m holds between steps. Rollback window 30m. Can @Theo @Ravi handle checks?

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: window reserved 22:30-00:30 UTC. Dry-run OK. CLI: `deployctl pin router --model v3.2.2 --mode tilt`

Theo: I'll run warmup and watch p95/p99.

Ravi: I'll monitor errors and backend traces, prepare fallback pin v3.2.0-quant.

Nina: Rollback triggers: >1% absolute error increase OR p95 +150ms OR repeated host p99 >1s. Pause 5m at each step; abort on any host-level tail repeat.

deploy-bot: warmup suggestion: `internal-warmup --model v3.2.2 --samples 1000`

Theo: warmup started. warmed=320/1000 ETA 3m.

Nina: Canary (2%) in ~30s.

Theo: Canary live. p95 210ms, errors +0.05% -> proceed to 20%.

Ravi: At 20% saw a p99 tail on host-az4-07 (GC pause). Draining host now: `routerctl drain host-az4-07`. Pausing ramps.

Nina: Hold. If another host shows same GC tail, we rollback.

deploy-bot: drain complete for host-az4-07. cluster p99 back to 440ms.

Theo: Resuming -> 70%. metrics: p95 +25ms, errors +0.2% -> within thresholds.

Nina: Proceed to 100% with 15m watch. Oncall please keep rollback command ready.

oncall-kyla: ACK. Rollback staged: `deployctl unpin router --model v3.2.0-quant`. Circuit breaker prepped.

Ravi: 100% applied. Final metrics: p95=235ms, p99=470ms, errors +0.3%. Posting short post-rollout note: "tilt->v3.2.2; single-host GC tail drained; rollout completed; pin retained 6h."

Nina: Thanks team. Close when notes and release tag `tilt-quiet-6794` are updated.
